# Ghibli Park

> Official website for Ghibli Park, a Studio Ghibli-themed attraction at Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park featuring five immersive areas inspired by beloved animated films.

Ghibli Park brings the worlds of Studio Ghibli to life through five distinct areas: Ghibli's Grand Warehouse, Hill of Youth, Dondoko Forest, Mononoke Village, and Valley of Witches. Located in Aichi Prefecture, Japan, the park offers visitors the chance to explore recreations of iconic settings like Howl's Castle, The House of Witches, and the Okino Residence.
